first_tooth_layer_control.scope: Exact thin-layer connectivity. A single section is not proof of a printable bridge.
first_tooth_layer_control.expected: All gusseted sections connect; at least one removed-gusset early layer has a detached tooth island.

iteration_history.rejected_feature: Original M2 pocket outer skin .8 mm
iteration_history.observation: At +/- .25 mm X, one zero-travel hook intersected the pocket skin by 1.1024719403 mm3 at each of Z offsets -.15, 0, +.15. Deliberate release was clear.
iteration_history.correction: Pocket skin .5 mm plus external .8 mm reinforcement; nominal radial clearance .45 mm. Subsequent 234-pose study had no operation collisions.

iteration_history.observation: Earliest tooth layers can be detached from the beam. The removed-gusset thin-layer control retains this mechanism.
iteration_history.correction: Integral end gussets support a nominal 9 mm bridge; receiver side relief preserves a central shelf. Actual slice still required.

operation_failure_interpretation: FAIL marks violation of the requested pure-clearance envelope. Zero-travel lateral-offset interference may require seated elastic leaf preload; it does not alone establish absent capture or product rejection. A deformable equilibrium is needed to resolve it.
liner_compatibility: NOT established; existing S16 is M1-specific
manufacturing_status: REJECTED: exact inverted-cap sections show detached first receiver-shelf layers after side relief removes transverse anchors. Body gussets alone do not solve printable undercut capture.
limitations: Normal direction establishes outward-seating geometry only; it does not predict holding force.
Hook contact may limit rocking before the fixed guide does; its interference is recorded separately.
First guide contact is not a bearing stiffness result or a full cap/body equilibrium.
Fixed-hook pose obstruction does not prove a force/energy barrier or continuous retention.
Axial negative deviations apply to leaf-vs-cap clearances; the hard seat independently blocks negative whole-cap travel.
Dimensional deviations are declared sensitivities, not measured print-error distributions.

cap_first_shelf_layer_control.scope: Exact 0.002 mm-thick sections of complete cap in its inverted print direction; isolated shelf strips are unsupported nominal layer islands.
cap_first_shelf_layer_control.expected: No detached section besides the continuous outer wall ring. More than one component demonstrates a floating shelf strip.
cap_first_shelf_layer_control.limitation: Connectivity alone is insufficient to qualify a bridge or actual deposition.
